An '''adjustable sprayer nozzle''' was a gardening tool equipped on [[Droid/Legends|droids]] such as the [[R0/5T.N1 tree feeder]]. The sprayer was connected to an articulated hose, and could be used to dispense [[Fertilizer/Legends|fertilizer]], organic [[pesticide]]s, and [[Water/Legends|water]].<ref name="EGTD" />
